_rule: The one source for install snippets. The site and docs both read this file, and a test keeps the contract valid against the real schema.

quickstart.title: Check your tools
quickstart.body: Open PowerShell on Windows or Terminal on Mac. Each command should print a version. You need Node.js 20.12 or later.

quickstart.title: Install Plumbline
quickstart.body: This adds the plumbline command to your computer.

quickstart.title: Connect an AI agent
quickstart.body: Plumbline uses your own account. The second command opens a sign-in. Prefer Claude Code? The guide has both.

quickstart.title: Open your project
quickstart.body: Replace the path with your project folder, then switch to the branch you want reviewed.

quickstart.title: Run your first review
quickstart.body: It can take several minutes. You get a merge score and a list of issues. Your code stays unchanged.

githubAction:
# .github/workflows/plumbline.yml
- uses: tanzir71/plumbline@v1
  with:
    model: claude-sonnet-5-5
    key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_KEY }}
gitlab:
# .gitlab-ci.yml
include:
  - remote: 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tanzir71/plumbline/v1/ci/gitlab/plumbline.yml'
# CI/CD variables: PLUMBLINE_MODEL_KEY, PLUMBLINE_GITLAB_TOKEN
contract:
version: 1
modules:
  api: ["src/api/**"]
  billing: ["src/billing/**"]
  users/session: ["src/users/session/**"]
layers:
  - [api]                 # HTTP handlers only
  - [billing, "users/*"]  # domain
rules:
  - id: no-billing-to-users
    forbid: billing -> users/*
    because: ADR-012 billing ships on its own
  - id: tenant-scope
    require: "repo methods scope by org_id"
    check: llm
proof: { P1: [failing_test, graph_diff, broken_rule] }
